subject: France
note: Hand-curated research for a Geographica episode about the time zones of France. Claims are cited to a pinned Wikipedia revision (trusted_secondary). Overseas France is shown by highlighting the country on the world map; individual territories are not labelled.

claims.text: With its overseas territories, France uses 12 different time zones (13 including its claim in Antarctica), more than any other country in the world.
Metropolitan France uses Central European Time (UTC+01:00) as its standard time.
All parts of Overseas France use different time zones from Metropolitan France.
